text: Because gasoline prices have skyrocketed, I couldn't go back to my hometown for Songkran this year. While I was there, I found a dental clinic near Pratunam that offered teeth cleaning and scaling, so I decided to try their services. The place is spacious, the staff are friendly, and the dentist was very gentle and gave good advice. I encourage you to give them a try.
